Water Features

Take your pool to the next level of luxury and relaxation with a water feature.

Elevate Leisure To Art With A Pool Water Feature

Immerse yourself in the ethereal beauty of swimming pool water features, where each element weaves a captivating dance on the water's surface. Envision deck jets, with their glimmering reflections, introduce a layer of playful shimmer, effortlessly commanding the eyes of beholders. Picture the smooth arc of a laminar stream and listen to the multi-tiered waterfall, its cascading tiers creating an auditory and visual harmony that transforms your swimming pool into a tranquil oasis. Water features make your pool not just a space for leisure but a sanctuary that mesmerizes and soothes the soul.

Water Feature Benefits

Pool water features have some amazing benefits.
Soothing Sound Of WaterEnhance relaxation with the soothing sound of falling water.
Elegance & Beauty Elevate your pool with customized water features.
Blocks Noise

Falling water helps reduce surrounding noise from other sources.

Improved CirculationThe circulation of water through a water feature improves water flow.

Your Sanctuary, Your Pool!

Escape to your very own sanctuary, a refreshing retreat that promises to cradle your senses in pure tranquillity. Imagine the gentle cascade of a crystal-clear waterfall, its soothing whispers merging seamlessly with the calm around you, creating an atmosphere of unparalleled peace and family enjoyment. As you glide into the welcoming grasp of your pool, the day's heat dissolves, replaced by a refreshing caress that rejuvenates. In your sanctuary, every moment is an indulgent experience, and every splash nurtures the soul with our most soothing water features.

Install A Water Feature With Your New Hipel Pool!

If you are considering a new pool with a water feature, Hipel Pools is here to help. We specialize in installing inground pools with or without an added water feature. Our team has installed over 100 pools and has the experience to deliver to you unmatched quality and customer satisfaction.

Let's get started on your pool project and we'll tailor our approach to meet your specific needs.
